Resolves #21653

*On Air at Eight* gives the director ten seconds of opening titles, a late guest and a ninety-second film. Dragging the film ahead of the interview changes the presenter’s next cue and gives the guest line ten seconds to spare. Take the cue to change the program picture. Leave the guest first and the channel goes to dead air.

![The full broadcast desk at 1440 × 900](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/7e83d3eca85a028c4312f24d5b4c50ff18f4bad4/review-evidence/21653/desk.jpg?raw=true)

Evidence: L3, real pointer, keyboard, clock, popup and catalog observations in headless Chromium → L3 required. Residual: the deployed v14 catalog launch follows the website cut.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Observation |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 · Opening | The studio clock shows 19:59:50. The rundown names the ready film, and the timing diagram shows the guest slot is 01:20 early. |
| AC-2 · Change the show | A real drop changes store order, the inline cue and the detached presenter cue. The feed stays on titles until the take. The unedited order produces dead air at 20:00:00. |
| AC-3 · Replay and keyboard | Replay restores the opening clock, status and records. A keyboard user can cue the film and take it on the phone-sized desk. |
| AC-4 · Presenter | The popup follows its own director. Separate desks in one SharedWorker have independent state. The presenter reports a disconnected director, and the inline cue remains usable when a popup cannot open. |
| AC-5 · Discover and launch | Apps, Lists & Galleries, and Multi-Window include the example. The Apps card decoded its published 1280 × 720 cover. Source, development, ESM and production launch the broadcast. |

## Deltas from ticket

The timing diagram compares the proposed order with the guest line’s fixed availability. The director can hold the rehearsal clock, run it in real time, or advance exactly to the next cue. The broadcast desk declares its dark theme. The inline and detached presenters still share one director’s provider, which now also publishes the director’s clock and live status. The catalog uses the existing Pages image path. [Published cover](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/149)

## Cold look

Whole Apps viewports at 1440 × 900, scrolled to the last catalog row. The public Apps URL still showed the deployed home page during capture. The left frame uses the pre-PR catalog from `6952886dce` in the same release-candidate Portal shell. The right frame uses this branch. Both loaded the published Pages artwork.

| Before · pre-PR catalog | After · On Air added |
| --- | --- |
| ![Apps group before On Air](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/7e83d3eca85a028c4312f24d5b4c50ff18f4bad4/review-evidence/21653/catalog-base.jpg?raw=true) | ![Apps group with On Air](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/7e83d3eca85a028c4312f24d5b4c50ff18f4bad4/review-evidence/21653/catalog-head.jpg?raw=true) |

Two independent readers graded the unlabeled pair in opposite orders. The first gave the baseline **7/10** and the change **8/10**. The skyline and *Night Edition* headline made the new example identifiable before reading its caption. The second saw the change first and gave it **7.5/10**, then gave the baseline **7/10**. Directing a live opening gave that reader a concrete reason to launch the example.

![The full broadcast desk at 390 × 844](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/7e83d3eca85a028c4312f24d5b4c50ff18f4bad4/review-evidence/21653/phone.jpg?raw=true)

Frame critique: the desktop keeps the clock, program, cue, rundown and timing verdict together. On the phone, both cue actions fit on the opening screen and the timing diagram sits below the fold. The gold **Take next cue** button makes it possible to air the failed lineup before the visitor chooses **Cue film first**. In the catalog, the dark cover contrasts with the neighboring office apps. The Multi-window badge overlaps part of its small rundown heading, and the Open live links take a closer look.

## Test Evidence

The broadcast tests drive the real popup, a pointer reorder, a timed failure and a keyboard rescue. They read the clock and the accessible status through the same transitions. The canonical catalog and capture-recipe tests exercise the shared image path. The full build and generated SEO route verifier passed.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Open the example from the deployed v14 catalog after the next website cut.

November 21 merge check: all 17 reviewed files landed unchanged on `dev` in [`6a40630f0a`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/commit/6a40630f0a75958df3dc44c2abc43fe2933c4e26). The launch check stays open for the website cut.
